final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT f.film_id AS film_id, f.rating AS rating, COUNT(i.inventory_id) AS cnt FROM film f LEFT JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id, f.rating), s2 AS (SELECT rating, AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM s1 GROUP BY rating), s3 AS (SELECT s1.film_id AS film_id, s1.rating AS rating, s1.cnt AS cnt, s1.cnt - s2.avg_cnt AS diff FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON CAST(s1.rating AS TEXT) = CAST(s2.rating AS TEXT)), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_all FROM s3) SELECT s3.film_id, s3.rating, s3.cnt, s3.diff, s3.cnt - s4.avg_all AS diff_all FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.avg_all IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff_all DESC LIMIT 10
